body:
Well, to my immediate friends and family I have a reputation for smoking a lot of pot. I've always found that weed is not a 'Gateway' drug, as so many have told me... but I have always had an interest psychedelics.
I had been wanting to try Salvia for some time, but the opportunity never came to me, and I didn't want to have to go out and get it because it wasn't THAT important to me.
Well, yesterday one of my really good friends called me up. He was at the park with the guys, and they were blazing. I had a little weed to pitch in, so I went. When I got there, some guy was there that I'd only seen like once before. He had the Salvia. I was high as hell, so I was down for pretty much anything. He asked me if I wanted to hit it, so I agreed. I had no idea what was about to happen to me.
We left the park and went to my friends house, and the guy busted out the Salvia. Jason, whos house it was, didnt want us smoking Salvia at his house cause we'd trip if front of his grandmother.
'Okay'
So we went to the parking lot behind the apartment complex. I was the only one out of all those guys hitting the Salvia, so I had enough trip-sitters.
I packed two fat bowls of it, and got about 2 pretty good rips out of each. It wasnt but 30 seconds later that it kicked in.
I had merged with the ground... The same way that I would be in the shallow end of a pool, half submersed in water, only it was concrete. I had a hard time walking, and supposedly I was screaming 'Why is this happening to me?!'
I could literally feel myself swimming through hard ass asphalt, a sensation of phyisical, materialized contact with the ground around me. My best guess for the triggering of that trip was because I was sitting on the ground when I smoked it, so I probably merged with the ground before I got up. My motor skills were in shambles, I almost fell a couple times.
I fell into an intense panic, I was terrified. I have a condition with too much heat for some reason, where I vomit if it gets too hot. Well, it was very nice out that day, a cool, overcast day.
I was burning up. The Salvia made me sweat uncontrolably. I layed down when we got back to the apartment, and couldnt stop shaking. I needed to move somehow, to forget the trip. It didn't. It was too intense.
I splashed my face with water three times, which helped to relieve the tension.
I will never, EVER do that shit again. EVER. I dont care how much you pay me.
